name: Finalize post 356 R2
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/finalize-post-356-r2.yml']
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: nhunnhun-post-356-finalize
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  finalize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: main
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm install --global pnpm@11.19.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: node maintenance/finalize-post-356-r2.mjs
        env:
          BROWSERBASE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_API_KEY }}
          BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID }}
          BROWSERBASE_CONTEXT_ID: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_CONTEXT_ID }}
      - name: Commit evidence
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add evidence/post-356-finalize-r2.json
          git commit -m "evidence: post 356 finalize R2 PASS"
          git push
